report_summary: The report provides unusually concrete replication evidence:311 identical LoopNextWord bodies in39seconds, correctly retaining orchestration alternatives. It distinguishes proxy/payload attempts from successful effects and notes missing permission and final-state evidence. Its cleanup section nevertheless contradicts its own June4 date and asserts manual work/live reduction beyond the records.
